summary_rationale: Apar Industries is a globally scaled, engineering-led industrial compounder holding #1 global share in aluminium/alloy conductors and top-3 global share in transformer oils, alongside a rapidly scaling specialty cables franchise (29.77% export mix in FY26; FY26 ROCE 32%, ROE 20.3%). Technical qualification moats (UL, IEC, IEEE, E-beam irradiation) and molten-metal adjacency at Jharsuguda underpin durable pricing power, while the August 2026 ₹2,500 Cr QIP structurally de-risked its historically acceptance-heavy working capital model (promoter dilution of -2.34% was purely QIP issuance, not insider selling). Key operational watches are US Section 232 metal tariffs, DDP transit working-capital absorption (₹800 Cr in transit in Q2 FY27), and conductor EBITDA/MT normalization from ₹43,012–₹50,739/MT toward management's ₹35,000–₹36,000/MT baseline.
